title: iPhone free for 30 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 30 min (since 03:56Z; the lease of arch-compositor-morph ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: compositor-morph (owner arch-compositor-morph; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of arch-compositor-morph takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: no phone job could start. The GPU-menu agent's status text mentioned its future iPhone check, so the alarm counted it as waiting now.
- I marked that check as "not startable yet": it needs the menu-open fix (c2) built and passing Chrome and Simulator first.
- The alarm clears with that; the iPhone stays connected, free and cool (33 °C).
What you need to do: nothing.
